description: Convert an audio file to another format (mp3, wav, ogg, flac, aac, m4a), optionally at the given bit rate such as 192k.

bitrate.description: Optional bit rate for the output audio, such as 192k.

format.description: Target audio format: one of mp3, wav, ogg, flac, aac, or m4a.

input.description: Path to the input audio file to convert.

output.description: Path to write the converted audio file to; its extension is replaced with the target format if it differs.

name: convert_audio
